question.text: For NRI clients, Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (DTAA) provides:

answer.text: Relief from paying tax in both home and source countries via credit or exemption

explanation.text: The Logic: DTAA: tax credit or exemption to avoid double taxation. India has DTAAs with many countries. The Trap: Without DTAA, same income may be taxed twice. Cross-Exam Context: X-B, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: Obtain Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from home country to claim DTAA benefits.
